final_answer:
**Amazon's total net sales for fiscal year 2024 were $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion).**

Supporting source: Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (accession 0001018724-25-000004), Consolidated Statements of Operations — "Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959" (in millions) [DOC-1].

Comparability note: No comparability issues apply to this single-period figure. The same statement presents comparative net sales of $574,785 million for FY2023 and $513,983 million for FY2022 [DOC-1], all on a December 31 fiscal year-end basis, so the periods are directly comparable if a growth calculation is needed (FY2024 vs. FY2023 growth of approximately 11.0%).

ANSWER: $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion) in net sales for FY2024
